_comment: TINK F313 — per-kind declarations consumed by `stone` (skills/workflow/scripts/stone). DAS-side, vault-wide: every anchor and every agent must agree on what a control file is named and how a stone line renders, so this lives beside the facet specs (DAS Stone.md, DAS Stone Design.md, DAS Stone Keys.md) rather than in ~/.config/. Format keys available in each template: {slug}. 'control' MUST be of the exact shape '{slug} WORD' — stone's header/self-section detection derives the fixed WORD suffix from it.
